summary: Razzia Type's Lay-theme (WordPress) page for RT Rondelle, a grotesque grown from public-transport signage. A single black, centred column reads as the designer's first-person essay: origin chapters with archival signage photos, a 'Design' chapter of three annotated metric diagrams, then three long style lists set as station names and platform announcements, colour-coded green, red and blue by weight group like transit lines. It ends with licence, trial and PDF pills, links to sister typefaces and credits.

instances.feel: Calm, confident, like a station sign at night
instances.learn: With no nav and no CTA, a centred name and one paragraph on black set the essay's reading pace from the first screen

instances.look: Chapter 'DESIGN', then three topics ('Vertical Proportions', 'Horizontal Proportions', the geometry note), each a station name in big white letters ('Hamburg', 'Oerlikon', 'Victoria') above the same word drawn in thin outline on grey metric lines with coloured annotations (x-height red, ascender green, descender blue; mathematical circles red over the o's; narrow letters boxed blue, wide letters green) and a small colour legend, followed by a paragraph
instances.learn: Show the solid word and its annotated outline stacked: the eye matches the measurement to the real shape, and a two-line colour legend replaces callouts
